message: Warm in-process session restart (Pi session_start reasons new/resume/fork/reload) left status bar and widget blank for restored non-running runs: restore() replays without appending, so version never bumped, and the ticker's lastVersion persisted across sessions in the same process.
resolution: Ticker is recreated inside every session_start handler (fresh lastVersion=-1) so the initial push repaints on warm restarts. Smoke Test 36 covers pause + second session_start({reason:resume}) repaint with unchanged version.

message: Test 35 called handle.stop() before invoking the session_shutdown handler, so the handler's clearInterval ran with interval===null; teardown was existence-tested, not behavior-tested.
resolution: Test 35 now invokes session_shutdown while the interval is live, then asserts zero interval-driven renders after a 1.2s wait.

message: Test 34 sole-writer regex matched only double-quoted literal setStatus/setWidget calls; single quotes, template literals, or identifier-bound surface IDs evaded it.
resolution: Regex now covers all quote styles; added a bare-string grep across src/** with explicit whitelist (phase-indicator.ts writer; state.ts/logging.ts/goal-commands.ts .pi path segments).

message: Framework behavior verified: setExtensionHeader re-invokes the factory on every call, so the per-tick same-factory re-push genuinely re-renders the header. Residual corner: a setHeader call during early initialization is silently dropped and only self-heals while a run is active.
resolution: No fix required; verified against pi-coding-agent interactive-mode.js setExtensionHeader.

message: Widget line 2 rendered an extra status icon not present in sec04 §4.3's fixed format table.
resolution: Status icon dropped; widget line 2 is now exactly `C{cycle} {icon} {phase} · {status}`.

message: A5's rendered percent was asserted for the calculateProgress formula but not for its placement; no smoke test asserted the modal dashboard output contains 'Progress: N%'.
resolution: DashboardComponent exported; Test 37 asserts the rendered modal line shows Progress: 0% then 75% after setPhase(validate)+invalidate().

message: Spec-text nit: sec04 §4.2 says goal-reset empty state follows a status_changed event, but stateManager.clear() appends no event; the imperative clearPhaseSurfaces path is the actual mechanism.
resolution: Spec wording inaccuracy recorded; code behavior correct.
